note: 7-day window (Aug 11-18). Thin cycle for US-remote fund/corporate freelance counsel. All 10 boolean clusters were run across Go Fractional, Fractional Jobs, Built In, Legal.io, ACC Jobline, GoInhouse, ZipRecruiter/Indeed/CareerBuilder aggregators, and Google-indexed LinkedIn results (LinkedIn was NOT bot-scraped). The aggregators returned almost entirely salary-index and directory pages rather than dated reqs; the fractional boards had fresh legal postings this week but most were geographically unusable for a US-based lawyer (Keyloop — Interim Head of Legal, Reading UK hybrid, Aug 13; Norven — fractional GC, Remote UK only, Aug 17; Visier — fractional Corporate Counsel, Remote Canada only, Aug 17). Those three were scored and dropped on geography, not on fit. 453 previously-captured company names were deduplicated out. The standout find is Scissero, an AI-native ALSP built specifically for private equity, capital markets and fund-related documentation, which is scaling its US legal delivery bench and just announced a Mayer Brown partnership on Aug 11 — squarely inside the window. WATCH ITEM (not counted in leads, company already in CRM from a prior run): Tower Legal Solutions has a live 'Contract Staff Attorney — Private Funds, Remote, NY-barred' req at $80-120/hr covering fund side letters, feeder fund formation documents and fund ops — the single closest match to Katie's practice found this cycle. It is documented in the markdown report but excluded from this leads array and from the import script because the import dedupes by company name and would skip it. As always, employmentTypeRaw records how the source frames the engagement; engagementModel records the commercial relationship Katie would actually pitch.
